featureDiscovery.notEvidence: Admission and observation availability are separate from source/execution claims

sitePolicy.development: explicit session connection with individual actions
sitePolicy.production: read-only by default; separate two-stage production input permission

guardian.scope: Resource admission and cleanup; not input or execution evidence

sourceAnalysis.scope: Explicit transient lexical source context only; no runtime values or execution

sourceParser.scope: Private session-only artifact parsing in the owned offscreen document; no source execution or public validated-map input

officialInfo.sourceTreeDigestMethod: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(sorted [repository-relative path, exact-file SHA-256] entries)
